headline: RWS Completes Acquisition of Acolad to Expand AI Content Services
summary: RWS has completed its acquisition of Acolad, expanding its portfolio of artificial intelligence content solutions alongside interpreting and transcription services for enterprise customers.
why: RWS Holdings is a UK-listed provider of technology-enabled language, content management, and intellectual property support services.

impacts.name: RWS Holdings plc
impacts.why: The completion of the acquisition brings new enterprise AI capabilities and integration costs.
